notablePrerequisites:
You control an animated land without summoning sickness that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
You control a white permanent.
description:
Activate an animated land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}, targeting the animated land.
Orvar and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Orvar trigger, creating a token copy of the animated land that is not a creature.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 2.
